title: Accounting & Bookkeeping Services in Nepal | Lalitpur Advisory
metaDescription: Professional accounting and bookkeeping services in Nepal. Transaction recording, VAT ledgers, bank reconciliation, and management reporting for businesses.
directAnswer: Professional accounting and bookkeeping services in Nepal ensure accurate day-to-day transaction recording, bank reconciliations, inventory coordination, and timely monthly financial reporting. Lalitpur Financial Advisory provides disciplined bookkeeping workflows that keep businesses compliant with IRD standards and fully prepared for annual statutory audits.
centerpieceSubtitle: Evaluate your firm's day-to-day record keeping, reconciliations, and reporting health to identify audit readiness.

sections.contentHtml:
Organized financial records are the bedrock of commercial stability. Our bookkeeping workflows follow strict standard operating procedures aligned with Nepalese accounting conventions:

Daily Ledger & Voucher Entry

Accurate classification of revenue, cost of goods, and operational expenses backed by valid serial-numbered tax invoices.

Bank & Cash Reconciliations

Monthly cross-matching of commercial bank statements against accounting software ledgers to eliminate unrecorded transactions.

Receivables & Payables Tracking

Aged debtor and creditor reports preventing bad debts and maintaining positive vendor relationships.

Monthly Management Accounts

Timely preparation of Trial Balance, Profit and Loss statements, and Balance Sheet summaries for executive review.

sections.h2: Bookkeeping vs. Accounting vs. Statutory Audit
sections.contentHtml: Clarity regarding roles prevents compliance failures. Bookkeeping is the mechanical, systematic recording of day-to-day commercial transactions and source documents. Accounting interprets, classifies, and summarizes these records into financial statements. Statutory Audits in Nepal are strictly governed under the Nepal Chartered Accountants Act 2053 and reserved exclusively for licensed ICAN members (Chartered Accountants and Registered Auditors). Our firm operates as an independent management consulting and accounting advisory practice; we manage bookkeeping workflows, internal controls, and pre-audit preparation to streamline external statutory audits.

faqs.question: Can your firm handle on-site and remote bookkeeping across Nepal?
faqs.answer: Yes. We operate hybrid bookkeeping setups utilizing modern accounting software, handling digital invoices, bank transaction exports, and scheduled physical voucher checks across Nepal.

faqs.question: How often will our business receive financial reports?
faqs.answer: Retained bookkeeping clients receive reconciled management accounts on a monthly basis, including P&L, balance sheet, aged receivables, and tax deduction (TDS) summaries.
